{{Top}}
{{Quote|Spaceports all smell the same. Engine exhaust, coolant fluid and spacers who haven't bathed in a week.|[[Mako (slicer)|Mako]]|<ref name="TOR:THoDK">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Hunt on Dromund Kaas|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>}}
[[File:HoundsTooth_Mos_Eisley_XWM.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The [[Hound's Tooth/Legends|''Hound's Tooth'']] departs [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] spaceport on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]]]
A '''spaceport''' or '''starport''' was a site for launching and receiving [[Starship/Legends|spacecraft]].

==History==
{{Quote|Mos Eisley Spaceport. You will never find a more wretched hive of scum and villainy. We must be cautious.|[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
Depending on the customs procedures of the [[Planet/Legends|world]], the spaceport could be [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] or planetside. Some planetary governments did not allow foreign spacecraft to enter the upper atmosphere and required visitors to dock their [[Starship/Legends|starships]] at an orbital spaceport, traveling to the surface using official [[Transport/Legends|transportation]].

In [[Herglese]], the term for a spaceport was ''shan-pakk''. Due to the influence of [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] trading in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], this term was widely used throughout the [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] built a [[Republic spaceport (Mos Osnoe)|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to profit from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] trade. However, it was destroyed by the Separatists under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]].

{{Struct-stub}}

==Classification system==
A spaceport could service multiple spacecraft in an official capacity and was open to any civilian vessel with proper clearance. In contrast, a landing pad was a private facility, typically capable of servicing one spacecraft at a time.

There were five different classes of starports, describing the magnitude of the landing facilities, the availability of goods and services and the amount of security. The classification system was maintained by the [[Imperial Space Ministry/Legends|Imperial Space Ministry]], which inspected and certified starports. The system was devised by the Galactic Republic and taken over with minimal change with the ascension of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="PSG14">''[[Platt's Starport Guide]]''</ref>

These classes were not absolute, but more generalizations. Costs, fees and availability of goods often depended on the local [[Star system/Legends|star system's]] [[Galactic economy|economy]], the state of the starport's administration and the funding, legal or otherwise. For example, those starports subsidized by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] often had lower costs. Also, different personalities of [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] officers and starport personnel and different local practices made each location unique.<ref name="PSG14" />

===Landing Field===
A flat open space, often made out of [[synthecrete]], with neither a [[Control tower/Legends|control tower]] nor guaranteed [[Fuel/Legends|refuel]] and repair services.<ref name="GG6">''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]''</ref> What was available was often affordable by the average [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], but lacked in quality.<ref name="PSG14" />

===Limited Services===
Open spaces with a small control tower and a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] that sometimes offered maintenance sheds for rent where repairs could be made by the [[Starship/Legends|ship]]'s crew.<ref name="GG6" /> Nearby areas were often used as landing fields if the starport was full and [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] and goods had to be purchased from outside the port due to its limited supply capacity.<ref name="PSG14" />

===Standard Class===
{{Main|Standard Class starport}}
These starports had fully staffed and equipped flight-control centers and on-site restocking services. The starport had a small shipyard and was capable of minor repairs and modifications. Costs for these services could go up to double the normal price and took twice as long to finish. Quality ranged from mediocre to very good.<ref name="PSG14" />

===Stellar Class===
{{Main|Stellar-class starport}}
The [[Standard Class starport]] had a fully staffed and equipped control tower and offered refueling and resupply services.<ref name="GG8">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]''</ref> They had a small [[Shipyard/Legends|maintenance facility]] capable of minor repairs and modifications, although these services could cost up to double the normal price and take more than twice as long to accomplish.<ref name="GG6" /> Stellar Class starports often had a [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Customs]] office on site and a large [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] presence in the system.<ref name="PSG14" />

===Republic Class/Imperial Class===
{{Main|Imperial-class spaceport}}
Republic or Imperial Class starports were the most luxurious and modern starports in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], often sprawling for hundreds of [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] and servicing thousands of vessels a [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="TRPGSERE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>. Originally named Republic Class during the days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], they were renamed Imperial Class during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. They were usually connected to other starports of the same class by a major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]]<ref name="RP">{{JournalCite|2|Rebel Privateers!}}</ref> and offered a wide array of docking facilities and the most lavish and advanced amenities and services were available for spacers. The system's companies and [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] had offices directly at the starport. A [[Captain/Legends|captain]] often didn't even need to leave the port to conduct all of their business.<ref name="PSG14" />

==Spaceport types==
===Wookiee===
The spaceports used by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] primarily utilized Wookiee-based architecture, and also had a plated dish rather than a circular dish tower.

===Gungan===
[[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] spaceports were primarily white with several odd structures. They had two hangars within the main white building. [[Sando HoverFreighter]]s were frequently used to load things on and off the vessels.

===Royal Naboo Security Forces===
The spaceports used by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] utilized the typical Naboo architecture. In addition, similar to the later Rebel Alliance variant, the satellite dish had a smooth, bowl shape.

===Trade Federation===
Similar to the later [[Imperial Spaceport]]s, the Trade Federation's spaceports during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] generally had a large satellite-dish array as well as a storage hangar. They also had an underground hangar used to launch large-scale starships. Neimoidian trader vessels were known to frequent this location to exchange materials for [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]].

===Grand Army of the Republic===
The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] spaceport design was primarily prismatic with some cyan touches, a garage, and an open hangar, as well as a four-pronged circular satellite dish.

===Separatists===
Mostly due to its original headquarters being on Geonosis, the Separatist spaceports were generally modeled after the caves of Geonosis. Unlike other spaceports used by various factions, it completely lacked a dish, although it did possess a spherical dome jutting out of the right side that eventually grew upon the spaceport's completion.

===Galactic Empire===
During the Galactic Civil War, Imperial-owned spaceports generally had a large satellite-dish array as well as a storage hangar guarded by a turret. They also had an underground hangar used to launch large-scale starships. Imperial Cargo Traders were known to frequent this location to exchange materials for nova crystals.

Kile II had such an Imperial spaceport before it was destroyed by Rogue Squadron.

===Alliance to Restore the Republic===
The Rebel Alliance variant was slightly similar in design to the Imperial variant. However, it had red colorings, and a basic dish tower instead of a spiked dish tower. In addition, the underground hangar was of a slightly different shape.
